description: All-in-one MCP bundle for EU businesses. Combines EU VAT Compliance (7 tools), CBS Statistics Netherlands (6 tools), and GDPR Compliance (6 tools) into a single 19-tool server. VAT validation, Dutch statistics, and data protection in one package.
